description: Create a new Pathrule workspace inside an organization. Cloud-only: writes the workspace row through the user's JWT (RLS enforces organization membership). Does NOT attach the workspace to a local folder, does NOT install any AI client config, and does NOT render CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md or editor companion files — those steps require Pathrule Studio or CLI. After creation, call pathrule_setup with the returned workspace_id to fetch the bootstrap brief.

active_agent_targets.description: AI clients this workspace will be used from. Affects Desktop/CLI companion file rendering when those surfaces attach. Defaults to ['claude-code'].

git_remote_url.description: Optional git remote URL (HTTPS or SSH form). Stored for reference and surface matching; never used to access the user's machine.

name.description: Human-readable workspace name (e.g. the project / repo display name).

name: pathrule_create_workspace

active_agent_targets.description: AI clients this workspace is configured for.

git_remote_url.description: Stored git remote URL, or null.

organization_id.description: Organization the workspace was created under.

workspace_id.description: UUID of the new workspace. Pass it to pathrule_setup next.

error.description: Present only when ok is false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, for example insufficient_scope, workspace_id_required, rate_limited, not_found, or upstream_error. Branch on this, not on message text.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the failure, for example { missing_scopes: [...] } on insufficient_scope.

human_message.description: One-line summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

local_runtime.description: Present on tools that carry the local-runtime upgrade reminder.

cta.description: Upgrade line to surface to the user when local Pathrule (Studio or CLI) would serve them better than Remote MCP.

next_step.description: The call to make next, as { tool, arguments }.

ok.description: true when the call succeeded. false when it did not, in which case `error` carries the reason and the success fields are absent.

title: Create Pathrule Workspace
